title: Cleaner home: notes, supplies and running late
question: Photos row locked. Now: how does Josh tell Carly about supplies, a problem, or running late? 'Running late' is a new note tag. It never stops the late flag; Carly just sees the reason beside it. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: A One 'Note for Carly' sheet
options.lineage: Same sheet pattern as 'Ask for extra time': chips first, typing optional
options.thesis: One row, one sheet. Pick a topic, tap what applies, send. Three taps for every kind of note.
options.viewport: Pass · rows · sheet: topic chips (Supplies low selected) · supply chips · text · red Send to Carly.
options.risk: Running late is one tap deeper (row → topic) than if it sat on the pass.

options.label: B Three quick tiles + late on the pass
options.lineage: Shortcut tiles, like a banking app's quick actions
options.thesis: Supplies / Problem / Note tiles under the pass, and a 'Running late' button on the pass before the shift starts.
options.viewport: Pass · three 72px tiles · rows · red Clock out.
options.risk: Tiles add a block of boxes to a calm list; three tiles push Next shifts down.

options.label: C Notes list with 'seen' and 'done'
options.lineage: A message thread for the shift
options.thesis: A 'Notes for Carly' section lists what you sent and whether Carly has seen or done it. 'Add' opens the sheet from A.
options.viewport: Pass · rows · Notes for Carly: 'Toilet paper, Paper towels · Carly has seen it' · 'About 10 min late'.
options.risk: Showing 'seen' needs Carly's dashboard to record when she opened a note: one new field.
